problem: Calls to the payment provider's POST /charges sometimes time out, and we don't know whether the charge went through
context: About 0.3% of charge requests time out after 10 s. Today we show the customer an error, and some customers then pay twice by retrying manually.
key_facts: The provider supports an Idempotency-Key header: repeating a request with the same key within 24 hours returns the original result instead of creating a new charge.
constraints: Must never charge a customer twice for one order

options.summary: Automatically retry the POST /charges request up to 3 times on timeout
Send an Idempotency-Key derived from the order id with every charge, and retry with the same key on timeout
Keep showing an error on timeout, and ask the customer to check their bank statement before retrying

criteria.description: Customers end up charged exactly once without manual effort

expected.why: Idempotency keys make retries safe; blind retries can double-charge; no_retry keeps the current harm.
